## Company

Name: CloudSwift Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Short name: CloudSwift
Founded: 2023
Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Other offices: Mumbai, India; Lewes, Delaware, USA
Website: https://oncloudswift.com
Tagline: Stop Wasting Cloud Spend. Start Scaling Securely.

## What CloudSwift Does

CloudSwift is a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP (Managed Service Provider) that designs,
migrates, secures, and operates cloud infrastructure for Indian startups, SMBs, and
enterprises. Core offering areas:

1. Managed Azure — landing zones, identity, cost optimisation, operations, monitoring
2. Cloud Migration — 6R assessments, wave planning, workload lift-and-shift or modernisation
3. Microsoft 365 — deployment, governance, security hardening, Teams, Exchange, SharePoint
4. Dynamics 365 — implementation and support for ERP and CRM
5. Managed Security — SIEM, endpoint, compliance, Azure Defender
6. AI Services — readiness assessments, enterprise ChatGPT integrations, intelligent agents,
   document intelligence, MLOps, generative AI workflows
7. Multi-cloud — AWS and Google Cloud alongside Azure
8. IT Help Desk — 24/7 managed support, 15-minute P1 response SLA

## Credentials and Certifications

- Microsoft Azure Expert MSP (fewer than 100 partners globally hold this designation)
- Microsoft Solutions Partner
- AWS Partner Network member
- Google Cloud Partner
- Oracle Cloud MSP
- ISO 27001 aligned
- SOC 2 Type II

## Service Statistics

- 450+ enterprise clients served across India, the Gulf, and the US
- 200+ cloud migrations completed
- 99.97% uptime SLA
- 15-minute critical (P1) incident response, 24/7/365
- ~87% first-call resolution rate

## Target Clients

Primary: Indian startups, growing SMBs, and mid-market enterprises (50–2000 employees)
who run or plan to run workloads on Microsoft Azure or Microsoft 365.
Also serves Gulf (UAE) and North American clients.
Industries: SaaS, manufacturing, BFSI, healthcare, logistics, government-adjacent.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is an Azure Expert MSP?
A: The Azure Expert MSP designation is Microsoft's highest-tier partner accreditation for
managed cloud services. Fewer than 100 partners hold it globally. It requires third-party
audits of technical capability, support processes, and customer outcomes.

Q: How fast does CloudSwift respond to incidents?
A: Critical (P1) incidents receive an engineer response within 15 minutes, around the
clock, 365 days a year.

Q: Does CloudSwift work with startups or only large enterprises?
A: CloudSwift works with Indian startups, SMBs, and mid-market companies. The managed
Azure and Microsoft 365 offerings are specifically designed to give smaller companies
enterprise-grade operations without building an in-house IT team.

Q: What regions does CloudSwift serve?
A: Primarily India (Bengaluru and Mumbai offices), with clients across the Gulf (UAE) and
North America (US entity in Delaware).

Q: How is CloudSwift different from a generic IT provider?
A: CloudSwift specialises exclusively in cloud and Microsoft platforms, holds the Azure
Expert MSP designation, and delivers under defined SLAs (99.97% uptime, 15-min P1
response). It is not a generalist IT services company.
